property: simple-agent/remote-manager philosophy, variable-oriented management model, and overall management architecture survive despite incompatible protocol syntax

sources.supports: RFC 1067 explicitly states that SNMP is not backward compatible with SGMP but that the original philosophy, design decisions, and architecture remain intact.

sources.locator: design goals and gateway monitoring model
sources.supports: Documents the SGMP philosophy being carried forward.

negative_claims: This edge does not claim wire compatibility between SGMP and SNMP.
It does not claim that every SGMP variable/object name survives into SNMP.
It does not establish HMP as a direct formal predecessor of SGMP.
open_questions: Which SGMP implementations were actually deployed on Proteon and other gateways?
Can source-code diffs between SGMP and early SNMP agents be recovered?
notes: Canonical example of architectural continuity despite wire incompatibility.
